# 1099-C Cancellation of Debt [2026]: Insolvency Exception and Tax Rules
> Last updated: 2026-09-25

> Got a 1099-C for debt cancellation? When forgiven debt is taxable, IRC 108 insolvency exception (Form 982), 1099-C statute of limitations, and bankruptcy cancellation of debt exclusions.

## About
1099cdebt.com is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
